MEET OUR DOCTORS

Our experienced team of dental professionals is committed to providing exceptional care with the highest standards of clinical excellence and patient comfort. We're your trusted go-to dentist in Knightdale, NC, for compassionate care.

Martin Clark Jr., DDS
MORE+
Martin Clark Jr., DDS
Dr. Clark was born in Washington, DC, and grew up in Durham, NC. His love for making people smile formed at an early age while watching his father, who he greatly admired, working as a dentist. This greatly influenced and inspired his choice in his own personal career path after graduating from Jordan High School. He earned his undergraduate degree from Morehouse College in Atlanta, GA, and his degree in dentistry from Howard University College of Dentistry in 1998. Dr. Clark has been married for almost two decades and is a proud father to his daughter. He enjoys movies, art, museums, concerts, and plays. Known for his honesty and compassion, he values treating others with the same care and respect he hopes to receive.
VIEW PROFILE
Lucas Nazario, DMD
MORE+
Lucas Nazario, DMD
Dr. Lucas Nazario graduated with honors from the University of Puerto Rico of Dental Medicine in 1999. He had his residency at Veteran’s Affairs Medical Center in Dayton, Ohio and practiced there for 6 years. Dr. Nazario enjoys spending time with his wife Gloria and his daughter Gabriella.
VIEW PROFILE
Rebecca Berg, DDS
MORE+
Rebecca Berg, DDS
Dr. Rebecca Berg grew up in upstate New York and earned her undergraduate degree from the University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill. It was during her time at UNC, while volunteering at North Carolina’s first Missions of Mercy outreach program, that she discovered her passion for dentistry. Seeing firsthand the impact of helping others regain their smiles inspired her to pursue a career in the dental field. Dr. Berg earned her dental degree from New York University College of Dentistry and served as a Dental Officer in the United States Navy. She completed a residency in Advanced Education in General Dentistry at Walter Reed National Military Medical Center. She is passionate about delivering exceptional, patient-centered care and helping each patient achieve a healthy, confident smile. In her spare time, she loves traveling and enjoying good food!
VIEW PROFILE
Bianca Speight, DDS
MORE+
Bianca Speight, DDS
Dr. Bianca Speight earned her DDS from the UNC School of Dentistry in 2015 after completing her Bachelor of Science in Health Education and Promotion at East Carolina University. Her passion for dentistry began during a high school internship at WakeMed, where she saw firsthand the impact dental care can have on overall health and confidence.

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
How often should I visit a dentist in Knightdale for checkups?

Regular cleanings are recommended as a twice-per-year activity for everyone. Keeping on top of your dental routines can prevent major problems down the road, so book your checkup today.

Do Knightdale dentists offer pediatric dental care?

Yes - we offer are for the whole family at our Knightdale location.

Do Knightdale dental offices accept insurance and payment plans?

We accept and participate with a large majority of insurance plans. Prior to any treatment, our team will perform a complimentary benefits evaluation to let you know what your insurance covers. We also offer flexible payment options and an affordable dental membership plan for patients without insurance.

Can a Knightdale dentist help with cosmetic treatments like teeth whitening or veneers?

Yes, we offer cosmetic treatments like professional tooth whitening, veneers, Invisalign® and more. If you have concerns for how your teeth look, give us a call today and we’ll help you explore options.

Do dentists in Knightdale offer emergency dental care?

Yes - we make every effort to accommodate dental emergencies on the same or next day, and if we’re unable to see you at our Knightdale location we can often accommodate last-minute needs at one of our other conveniently located practices.
